encoding: UTF-8 JSON; no BOM; sorted object keys; compact separators; one terminal LF; integer-only numbers; reject duplicate keys, floats, NaN, unknown fields and surrogate characters
record_identity: sha256:<lowercase hex SHA-256 of exact canonical envelope bytes>; raw payload bound by payload_sha256 and payload_bytes
conflict_linearization: actual pointer observation, exact request digest and CONFLICT outcome are committed together before returning; resolve preserves the observed actual pointer after a later advancement
ledger_validation: closed schema and recomputed semantic linkages before dedupe, resolve or verified local state; invalid ledger is UNKNOWN/BLOCKED_INTEGRITY
authority_semantics: none; SyntheticAdmission is a fixture, not an issuer/verifier of real credentials
